Not sure how I feel about the information represented here. A lot of it is useful, but there seems to be some nit picking (2013 survey yet statistics on schools from 2002 etc). Most of it is common sense, never hit a child in anger. That is when you time out and walk away. Age is also a factor, would never spank a child under 4 but usually 5-7 depending on their mental cognition or recognizing appropriate behavior. In all actuality it should only be done once if it's necessary at all. The fear of the consequence is 10x stronger then the actual act of spanking. If you can carry a reasonable conversation with your child then you shouldn't spank at all since they have the mental ability to reason and understand. Power of the mind, not threat of pain is the key.
